preconditions.expression: isinstance(root, TreeNode) or root is None
preconditions.description: The root is either a TreeNode or None.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(path, list) for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each path in the return value is a list.

postconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(node_value, int) for node_value in path) for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each node value in the paths is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(path) == target_sum for path in return_value)
postconditions.description: The sum of each path equals the target_sum.

postconditions.expression: all(path[0] == root.val for path in return_value if root is not None)
postconditions.description: Each path starts from the root node if the root is not None.
